'''Glet-mites''' were small pests native to [[Nam Chorios/Legends|Nam Chorios]]. A group of mites were hormonally modified by a [[Kubaz/Legends|Kubaz]] chef, under the employ of [[Beldorion]], to grow to huge proportions for the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] to eat. The chef also discovered how to use [[hall d'main]] excretions to complement the glet-mite's teleological system.
